facts.fact: The NCC guidance note states that critical national information infrastructure was designated by a Presidential Order and an Official Gazette order of 2024, and that telecom operators whose systems are so designated must report incidents to the NCC through CNII escalation protocols, on top of reporting to NCC-CSIRT within 4 hours.
facts.system: Designation and Protection of CNII Order, 2024

facts.fact: The guidance note, published 2026-07, states that service providers must notify ngCERT of significant breaches and follow advisories issued by ngCERT, showing the national CERT operating.
